class.name: NetwEntity
class.brief_description: The identity of one networked node, player or server-owned.
class.description:
One networked entity is one root node holding one [NetwEntity]. Nodes under the root read it to learn who the entity is, who controls it, and when it spawns and despawns. [codeblock] NetwEntity.of(node) # walks up to the entity, null when there is none Netw.configure_entity(self) # gets or creates it on a root, in _init [/codeblock] [member controller] and [member authority] are settled before the node enters the tree, so [member is_controlled_locally] and [method Node.is_multiplayer_authority] are already correct in [method Node._enter_tree] and [method Node._ready] on every peer. [codeblock] var entity := NetwEntity.of(hit_node) if entity and entity.player: eliminate(entity.peer_id) [/codeblock] [b]Declaring an entity[/b] A root declares itself in [code]_init[/code]. A child marks its own spawn properties in its [code]_init[/code] and connects to the entity in [method Node._ready], once it has a parent to walk up to. [codeblock] # on the root func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_entity(self) Netw.configure_property(self, &"position").on_spawn()
# on a child func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_property(self, &"health").on_spawn()
func _ready() -> void: NetwEntity.of(self).despawning.connect(_on_despawning) [/codeblock] A node placed in a scene by hand can set its own [member name]. A spawned copy receives it with the spawn. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_entity(self).name = &"ball" [/codeblock] [b]Control and authority[/b] [constant AUTHORITY_SERVER] keeps Godot multiplayer authority on the server while [member controller] steers. [constant AUTHORITY_CONTROLLER] moves Godot authority with control. Properties configured with [method NetwPropertyConfig.state] are server-written in both modes. [member NetwSimulation.claim_on_contact] and [member NetwSimulation.release_on_rest] let a body take control of what it touches and hand it back once it rests. [b]Letting the controller spawn and despawn[/b] Only the server spawns, moves and despawns an entity by default. When [member lifecycle] is [constant LIFECYCLE_CONTROLLER] the [member controller] may too, and the change shows on its screen at once. The server can refuse it in [signal lifecycle_requested], and the change is then undone on the controller. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_entity(self).lifecycle = NetwEntity.LIFECYCLE_CONTROLLER [/codeblock] [b]Simulation[/b] [member simulation] says how the entity's body runs on each peer, [member prediction] how a controller runs it ahead, and [member display] how it is drawn. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: var entity := Netw.configure_entity(self) entity.simulation.replicas = NetwSimulation.REPLICAS_ACTIVE entity.prediction.archetype = NetwPrediction.ARCHETYPE_SOLVER_BODY [/codeblock]

method.name: claim_control
method.description: Asks the server to make the local player the [member controller] with [param hold]. The returned [NetwPromise] resolves with this entity once the decision reaches this peer. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED another peer's hold or control_requested refused it ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE transfer does not allow a claim, or it is ┃ TRANSFER_IMMEDIATE on an entity with a state() ┃ property, prediction or a MultiplayerSynchronizer ┖╴ERR_TIMEOUT no decision arrived within one second [/codeblock] Under [constant TRANSFER_IMMEDIATE] this peer runs the node before the decision. A refusal restores the controller's latest values. [codeblock] entity.claim_control(NetwEntity.HOLD_SOFT) \ .then(func(_held: NetwEntity) -> void: pick_up()) \ .catch_error(func(_code: Error, _detail: String) -> void: shrug()) [/codeblock] [b]Player request.[/b]

method.name: despawn
method.description:
Frees [member root] after emitting [signal despawning] and saving its [member persistence]. Entities under it despawn too, unless their [member on_parent_despawn] is [constant PARENT_DESPAWN_DETACH]. [codeblock] entity.despawn()
var opts := NetwDespawnOpts.create(&"killed") opts.flush_save = false entity.despawn(opts) [/codeblock] The server may call it, and so may the [member controller] of a [constant LIFECYCLE_CONTROLLER] entity.

method.name: of
method.description: The [NetwEntity] of [param node]'s entity root, walking up the parents, or [code]null[/code] when [param node] is under no entity. It works off the tree too. [method Netw.configure_entity] declares a root.

method.name: release_control
method.description: Hands control of this entity to [param successor], which is the server by default. The returned [NetwPromise] resolves with this entity once the decision reaches this peer. The request carries this peer's latest [method NetwPropertyConfig.broadcast] values, and [param successor] starts from them. Values larger than 1024 bytes are not sent, and [param successor] starts from its own copy. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER successor is not a peer id ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED this peer neither controls the entity nor is claiming it ┖╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE successor holds no copy of the entity [/codeblock] [b]Player request.[/b]

members.member: Who holds Godot multiplayer authority for the root and its children. Set it before tree entry. Later changes are refused. At spawn, a non-server Godot authority on the root selects [constant AUTHORITY_CONTROLLER] if neither [member controller] nor this mode was explicitly assigned.

The player that steers this entity, or [code]null[/code] when the server controls it. It can differ from [member player], since a player can steer a server-owned entity. A write in the spawn function sets the starting controller. After that, only the server can write it, and [member hold] resets to [constant HOLD_NONE]. Writing [code]null[/code] hands the entity to the server. See [method claim_control] for a player request. [codeblock] car.entity.controller = Netw.session(self).local_player [/codeblock]
The entity's [NetwDisplay], which configures how the entity is drawn. A single value is smoothed with [NetwInterpolate].
How strongly [member controller] keeps this entity against other players' claims. While the server controls it, the hold is [constant HOLD_NONE].
The entity's [NetwInterest]. Never [code]null[/code], and what is declared on it survives leaving and re-entering the tree.
[code]true[/code] while a [method claim_control] from this peer is waiting for its decision.

[code]true[/code] when a player on this peer controls the entity, or is claiming a [constant TRANSFER_IMMEDIATE] entity. An entity the server controls reads [code]false[/code] everywhere, the server included. It does not depend on [member authority].

Who may spawn, move and despawn this entity. Set it in [code]_init[/code] beside [member transfer]. A refused call pushes an error and returns its failure value. [method Node.reparent] cannot be refused, so it warns and the move stays on this peer. During a prediction replay these calls return [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_BUSY] with no error, so a predicted step spawns only on a fresh tick. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: var entity := Netw.configure_entity(self) entity.lifecycle = NetwEntity.LIFECYCLE_CONTROLLER [/codeblock]

The name that identifies this entity on every peer and in logs. A save finds its row by [method NetwPersistenceConfig.record_id]. An entity left without one is named after the scene, spawn function or node it came from, followed by [code]@[/code] and its route, such as [code]Crate@3[/code]. [method Netw.spawn_player] sets it to the player's [member NetwPlayer.username], so a game giving one player several entities sets a distinct name on each.
What happens to the entity when its [member controller] disconnects. An entity spawned for a player still despawns with its [member peer_id].
The peer of [member player], or [code]0[/code] for an NPC or prop. The root appears in [member NetwPlayer.entities] and despawns when that peer disconnects, whoever its [member controller] is.
Loads and saves properties configured with [method NetwPropertyConfig.persisted]. See [NetwPersistenceConfig].
The entity's [NetwPrediction], holding its prediction settings and counters. Never [code]null[/code]. How the entity steps is on [member simulation].

Relative priority when a peer's bandwidth cannot carry every property update. [code]4.0[/code] sends about four times as often as [code]1.0[/code] when both keep changing. Must be greater than zero. [member interest] determines which peers receive updates.
The [RID] that [NetwMultiplayer] methods take for this entity. [codeblock] var state := Netw.of(self).entity_get_state(entity.rid) [/codeblock]
The root [Node] that holds this entity, or [code]null[/code] once it is freed.
The nearest scene at or above [member root], or [code]null[/code] when no scene was found. [codeblock] if NetwEntity.of(shooter).scene == NetwEntity.of(target).scene: apply_damage() [/codeblock]
How this entity's body runs on each peer, and which other entities it runs here. Never [code]null[/code].

Whether peers may request control through [method claim_control]. [constant TRANSFER_IMMEDIATE] selects [constant AUTHORITY_CONTROLLER] when [member authority] was not set, and is refused with an explicit [constant AUTHORITY_SERVER]. Set it before tree entry.

signal.name: control_changed
signal.description: Emitted once on each peer when [member controller] changes, after the multiplayer authority has moved under [constant AUTHORITY_CONTROLLER].

signal.name: control_requested
signal.description: Emitted on the server when a peer calls [method claim_control]. Calling [method NetwControlRequest.deny] on [param request] refuses it, whatever the listener order. Not emitted when a [member hold] already refuses the request.

signal.name: despawned
signal.description: Emitted once the entity has been freed, by [method despawn] or by freeing [member root] directly. [member root] may already be [code]null[/code], so cleanup that needs the node belongs in [signal despawning].

signal.name: despawning
signal.description: Emitted right before [method despawn] frees the entity, with its [param reason], while [member root] can still be read. Freeing [member root] directly does not emit it.

signal.name: hidden
signal.description: Emitted on a client that loses its copy of the entity without the entity being despawned, such as a hide under [constant NetwInterestLayer.LEAVE_POLICY_HIDE]. The entity may come back later with the same [member rid]. Neither [signal despawning] nor [signal despawned] is emitted, so anything tied to an entity that may return connects here.

signal.name: lifecycle_refused
signal.description: Emitted on the peer whose spawn, despawn or move of this entity the server refused, before the change is undone. [member NetwLifecycleRequest.reason] is what the server passed to [method NetwLifecycleRequest.deny], or empty when the server refused for another reason.

signal.name: lifecycle_requested
reparented
signal.description: Emitted once after the entity moves to a new parent, by [method Node.reparent], [method Netw.reparent], or [method Node.remove_child] followed by [method Node.add_child]. Read the new parent from [member root]. [code]_exit_tree[/code] also runs during a move, so teardown that must happen once belongs in [signal despawning] or [signal hidden]. [codeblock] NetwEntity.of(self).reparented.connect(reset_smoothing) [/codeblock]

constants.constant: The server holds the multiplayer authority whoever the [member controller] is.
The [member controller] holds the multiplayer authority, and it moves with every change of control.
Peers may ask the server for control.

Like [constant TRANSFER_REQUESTABLE], and the asking peer runs the entity before the decision arrives. A refusal puts back the controller's latest values. Not available on an entity with a [method NetwPropertyConfig.state] property, prediction, or a [MultiplayerSynchronizer].

Held, another player's [constant HOLD_NONE] or [constant HOLD_EXCLUSIVE] claim can take the entity. As a claim, it can take the entity from a player who does not hold it with [constant HOLD_EXCLUSIVE].
As a claim, it takes the entity only while the server controls it. Held, it is returned to the server when the body rests under [member NetwSimulation.release_on_rest].
Held, every other player's claim is refused, and only the server writing [member controller] moves the entity. As a claim, it behaves like [constant HOLD_NONE].
The server takes control when the controller disconnects.
The entity despawns when its controller quits or is kicked. After a drop or [method NetwSession.step_away] it despawns when [member NetwSessionConfig.return_window_seconds] runs out.
The entity despawns with the entity above it.
The entity moves up to its despawning parent's own parent, keeping where it stands. A held item drops where its holder stood.
Only the server spawns, moves and despawns the entity. Other peers are refused with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAUTHORIZED].

The [member controller] may also spawn, move and despawn the entity, and a peer that spawns one becomes its controller. Other peers are refused with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAUTHORIZED]. A predicted entity, an entity spawned for a player, and an entity replicated by a [MultiplayerSynchronizer] or [MultiplayerSpawner] allow only the server, and refuse other peers with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE].
